items.sum: Canada and Tunisia have expanded their air transport agreement. Minister of Transport Steven MacKinnon made the announcement.

items.title: Canada updates audiovisual coproduction treaties with UK and Spain
items.sum: The Government of Canada has modernized its audiovisual coproduction treaties with the United Kingdom and Spain. These agreements are intended to strengthen Canada's audiovisual sector through international partnerships.

items.title: Canada increases energy collaboration with Indo-Pacific countries
items.sum: Canada's Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Energy and Natural Resources attended the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Energy Ministers' Meeting in China from September 8-11, 2026, marking Canada's first political representation at this meeting in over a decade. The visit aimed to expand Canada's energy relations and trade partnerships in the Asia-Pacific region.

items.title: CBSA removes over 100 individuals from extortion networks
items.sum: The Canada Border Services Agency took action against extortion networks, resulting in more than 100 removals. These efforts were part of a broader strategy to disrupt organized criminal activity involving extortion.

items.title: Infrastructure announcement planned for Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory
items.sum: An infrastructure announcement will be made in the Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory involving the Member of Parliament for Bay of Quinte and the Chief of the Mohawks of the Bay of Quinte.

items.title: Federal funding allocated for water and wastewater infrastructure in Selwyn
items.sum: The federal government is investing in water and wastewater systems in Selwyn to support housing development and community resilience. This funding is part of efforts to build infrastructure that enables increased housing supply.

items.title: Federal government invests $60 million in menstrual product access program
items.sum: The federal government announced a $60 million investment to extend a national pilot project that provides access to menstrual products through Food Banks Canada. The funding aims to improve affordability and accessibility of essential menstrual products.

items.title: Government establishes tax certainty framework for major investments
items.sum: The Government of Canada is implementing measures to provide tax clarity for large-scale investment projects. This is intended to help investors make decisions about building projects in Canada.

items.title: Government marks National Coaches Week
items.sum: The Government of Canada is observing National Coaches Week. Secretary of State van Koeverden participated in the celebration.

items.title: Canada funds gun violence prevention program in Cape Breton
items.sum: The Government of Canada is providing financial support to Cape Breton, Nova Scotia to help prevent gun and gang violence. The investment is part of a broader national strategy to reduce firearm-related violence in communities across the country.

items.title: Canada participates in multilateral maritime cooperative activity

items.title: Statistics Canada reports high participation in 2026 Census

items.title: Commission établit taux cotisation assurance-emploi pour 2027
items.sum: La Commission de l'assurance-emploi du Canada a annoncé les taux de cotisation pour 2027 : 1,64 $ par 100 $ de salaire pour les employés et 2,30 $ pour les employeurs. Ces taux prendront effet le 1er janvier 2027.

items.title: Prolongation de l'allègement de la taxe d'accise fédérale sur l'essence

items.title: Le Canada annonce des investissements pour les entreprises du Yukon
items.sum: Le gouvernement du Canada annoncera des mesures de soutien financier destinées aux entreprises du Yukon pour les aider à s'adapter aux perturbations commerciales et à saisir de nouvelles opportunités. L'annonce sera faite par la ministre des Affaires du Nord et de l'Arctique et le secrétaire parlementaire du Yukon.

items.title: Canada modernise traités coproduction audiovisuelle Royaume-Uni Espagne
items.sum: Le Canada a modernisé ses traités de coproduction audiovisuelle avec le Royaume-Uni et l'Espagne. Ces accords visent à renforcer le secteur audiovisuel canadien par des partenariats internationaux.

Cette démarche vise à attirer des investissements, créer des emplois et diversifier le commerce dans le secteur énergétique.

items.sum: L'Agence des services frontaliers du Canada a mené des opérations contre les réseaux d'extorsion, ce qui a entraîné plus de 100 renvois. Ces efforts visent à combattre les activités criminelles liées à l'extorsion.

items.sum: La ministre Valdez annonce un investissement de 60 millions de dollars pour prolonger le projet pilote national du Fonds d'équité menstruelle, qui vise à améliorer l'accès aux produits menstruels essentiels. Ce programme est mis en œuvre par Banques alimentaires Canada.

items.sum: Le gouvernement du Canada annonce des mesures visant à clarifier les règles fiscales pour les grands investisseurs afin de réduire l'incertitude et de faciliter la réalisation de leurs projets.

items.sum: Le secrétaire d'État van Koeverden annonce la tenue d'un sommet rassemblant la communauté sportive. Cet événement vise à transformer et renforcer le système sportif canadien dans le cadre de l'Année du sport au Canada.

items.sum: Le secrétaire d'État van Koeverden a annoncé des mesures visant à utiliser le sport pour renforcer le Canada. Le gouvernement a également reconnu l'investissement de Capital Power dans Canada Alpin.

items.sum: The Secretary of State will participate in a Field Hockey Try-It Day event in Calgary alongside Ward 5 Councillor Raj Dhaliwal. The event aims to introduce residents to field hockey and encourage sports participation.

items.sum: Public Services and Procurement Canada is closing the Alexandra Bridge to vehicle traffic to conduct inspection work. The closure is temporary while maintenance assessments are performed.

items.title: Canada regains beef export market access to Dominican Republic
items.sum: The Canadian Food Inspection Agency announced that the Dominican Republic has approved imports of Canadian beef and beef products from cattle of all ages. This restores market access for these Canadian exports.

items.sum: The Government of Canada issued a statement to mark Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year celebration. The statement was released by Minister Miller.

items.sum: The federal government is providing investment to Atom-Jet Industries in Brandon through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative. The funding will support the company in expanding production and increasing sales across Canada.

items.sum: Le 2 septembre 2026, du personnel de l'Établissement de Stony Mountain a saisi des colis contenant des objets interdits et non autorisés. Cette saisie a été possible grâce à la vigilance des agents.
